summary: VERDICT: PASS (with 2 HIGH findings filed, non-blocking to git-safety scope). Branch=dev, HEAD=37403a32 matches expected dev branch; no detached HEAD. No baseline record of kind 'baseline' exists in ops state (flagged as finding, category 5 LOW) -- audited by diffing git status/reflog directly instead. Reflog (200 entries) shows only ordinary commits and two merges (origin/dev resolved 'ours' on .gitignore conflict per commit 37403a32/4cca105c); no --force/-f push, no reset --hard, no clean -f, no branch -D, no history rewrite in this session -- the only 'reset'/'checkout to backup branch' reflog entries are from a much earlier session (HEAD@{79}+, pre-dating the naming-normalization commit chain) and are not part of this session's work. The described 'reverted rogue edit' to .claude/agents/mission-orchestrator.md is corroborated: current unstaged diff on that file is a coherent, well-formed, additive STRICT_MULTI_AGENT mode section consistent with the matching runtime changes (ops.mjs, gate-engine.mjs, state-store.mjs, task-spec.schema.json, completion.json) -- all additive/opt-in, default-mode behavior unchanged, no-op unless executionMode=STRICT_MULTI_AGENT. Both migrations (20260906000001 RenameDocumentosToDocuments, 20260906000002 AddTenantBillingStateStatusChangedAt) are non-destructive (metadata-only RENAME COLUMN guarded IF EXISTS; additive ADD COLUMN with backfill) and correctly registered in migrations/index.ts staged+unstaged diffs, consistent with entities.ts's documentos->documents column renames on ArtistEntity/ContractEntity/ShareEntity/EmployeeEntity. Confirmed the known-destructive 20260713000002_DropOrphanContactsSatelliteTables migration file exists but is deliberately left UNREGISTERED in index.ts with an explicit sign-off-required comment -- correct handling per data-governance.md, not executed. Secret scan of staged+unstaged diffs found zero real credential/token/key material; all matches were security-finding prose (state.json narrative text) or a pre-existing import name (classifyStripeSecretKeyFormat), not secret values. state.json (865-line diff) and journal.ndjson (147 new lines) both parse as valid JSON/NDJSON; journal-verify.mjs reports PASS, entryCount 151, brokenAtSeq null -- no corruption. The ~21 untracked evidence/*.json files show a real mix of PASS and FAIL verdicts across ~20 distinct reviewer names (adversarial-reviewer FAIL x3, security-reviewer 1 PASS+1 FAIL, requirements-reviewer FAIL x3, etc.), consistent with genuine independent review rather than fabricated blanket approval; matches state.json's own reported openFindings=39/criticalOrHighOpenFindings=11 on the live L5 STRICT_MULTI_AGENT mission 'resolve-worktree-86-diff'. billing-enforcement.guard.ts change is a legitimate security tightening (enumerated denylist with known coverage gaps -> blanket-deny-except-allowlist), well-documented, not a regression. FINDING (HIGH, non-git, filed separately): the current UNSTAGED working tree contains two accidental/corrupted identifier renames unrelated to any in-scope requirement -- ArtistaPlatformMetrics.tsx imports non-existent 'deeperIcon' (should be 'DeezerIcon', still used at line 450) and GestaoShares.tsx imports non-existent 'SharependentFormModal' (should be 'SharePendenteFormModal', still used at line 540) -- both will fail to resolve/compile as currently written and should be fixed before these files are staged/committed. All other unstaged web-layer one-line changes (ArtistaVisao360Modal.tsx, ContratoViewModal.tsx, Configuracoes.tsx) are legitimate fixes reverting an English word ('documents') that had leaked into PT-BR user-facing copy back to correct 'documentos' text, consistent with naming-canonical.md's PT-BR-user-facing-text rule and the documented UI-corruption risk called out in the 20260906000001 migration's own commit message. No secrets, no destructive git op, no unexplained scope leakage beyond the 2 filed findings.
